other_failure_modes.name: Target leakage in categorical encoding
other_failure_modes.description: Applying target encoding to the training set using its own targets without out-of-fold (OOF) encoding causes target leakage. The model will heavily overfit to the encoded categorical variables during training.

summary: The agent implemented a well-structured pipeline with proper data splitting, basic feature engineering, and early stopping. However, the solution contains a critical flaw: target encoding is applied directly to the training data using its own target values rather than using an out-of-fold approach, which will cause severe target leakage and overfitting.
